description: FHIR R4 Encounter resource — an interaction between a patient and healthcare provider(s) for the purpose of providing healthcare service(s) or assessing the health status of a patient.

fields.label: Resource ID
fields.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource.

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: Identifier(s) by which this encounter is known.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: The current state of the encounter. Values: planned | arrived | triaged | in-progress | onleave | finished | cancelled.

fields.label: Class
fields.description: Concepts representing classification of patient encounter such as ambulatory (outpatient), inpatient, emergency, home health or others.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Specific type of encounter (e.g. e-mail consultation, surgical day-care, skilled nursing, rehabilitation).

fields.label: Service Type
fields.description: Broad categorization of the service that is to be provided (e.g. cardiology).

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Indicates the urgency of the encounter.

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: The patient present at the encounter. Reference to Patient or Group.

fields.label: Participant
fields.description: The list of people responsible in some way for the encounter.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: The start and end time of the encounter.

fields.label: Length
fields.description: Quantity of time the encounter lasted (less time absent).

fields.label: Reason Code
fields.description: Reason the encounter takes place, expressed as a code.

fields.label: Diagnosis
fields.description: The list of diagnosis relevant to this encounter.

fields.label: Hospitalization
fields.description: Details about the admission to a healthcare service.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: List of locations where the patient has been during this encounter. Reference to Location.

fields.label: Service Provider
fields.description: The organization that is primarily responsible for this encounter's services. Reference to Organization.
